tagline: A premier provider of natural gas compression services and a leading supplier of aftermarket services, supporting essential midstream compression operations across the U.S. energy infrastructure.
hero_kpi_rationale: Contract operations revenue is the primary driver of AROC's business, representing the majority of its revenue and reflecting the essential demand for natural gas compression services in the energy sector.

kpis.name: Contract Operations Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the design, ownership, operation, and maintenance of AROC's natural gas compression fleet for its customers.
kpis.description: 30% increase in contract operations revenue in 2025, reflecting strong demand for natural gas compression services.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in core revenue, indicating strong demand.

kpis.name: Total Operating Horsepower
kpis.explanation: The total capacity of the natural gas compression equipment fleet operated by the company.
kpis.description: 8% increase in total operating horsepower in 2025 to 4,571 thousand horsepower, supporting revenue growth.
kpis.signal: Expansion of physical capacity to meet growing demand.

kpis.name: Aftermarket Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from support services for customers who own their own compression equipment.
kpis.description: Aftermarket services provide a full range of services to support compression needs for customers who own their own equipment.
kpis.signal: Indicator of installed base and maintenance activity.

kpis.name: NGCS Acquisition Consideration
kpis.explanation: Total cost of the NGCS acquisition, including cash and stock.
kpis.description: Acquisition of NGCS for $349.4 million, adding an operating fleet of 326,000 horsepower and a backlog of 18,000 horsepower.
kpis.signal: Strategic acquisition to increase capacity and backlog.

kpis.name: Contract Operations Backlog

risks.title: Access to Capital and Costly Financing
risks.score_rationale: The risk is documented as critical in the context of recent acquisitions (NGCS for $349.4M) and debt repayments (2027 Notes for $300M), with significant reliance on borrowings under the Credit Facility. The 10-K explicitly states: 'there is no guarantee in our ability to access the debt and equity markets to raise capital on affordable terms in 2026 and beyond'. The language indicates an existential risk if financing is not available timely or on affordable terms.

risks.title: Input Cost Pressures and Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The factor is explicitly discussed in the 'Key Challenges and Uncertainties' section with moderate to high intensity. The 10-K states: 'Significant price increases for these inputs, as a result of inflation, tariffs, or otherwise, could adversely affect our operating profits. Supply chain disruptions could also adversely affect our ability to obtain, or increase the cost of, such items.' Pressure persists with direct impact on operating margins.

risks.title: Dependence on U.S. Natural Gas Production
risks.score_rationale: The direct and fundamental link between demand for compression services and U.S. natural gas production is emphasized in the 10-K: 'The key driver of our business is the production of U.S. oil and natural gas' and 'Demand for our services is dependent on the demand for natural gas in the markets we serve'. A production decline would materially impact revenues. The language is direct and repeated, indicating a central risk to the business model.

risks.title: Increased Competition and Pricing Pressure in the Compression Sector
risks.score_rationale: The risk is identified in the 'Key Challenges and Uncertainties' section of the 10-K. While the language is not alarmist, competition is explicitly cited as a key factor that could affect pricing and profitability. The context of strong demand (production at record levels in 2025) may attract new entrants.

risks.title: Energy Transition and Demand for Natural Gas-Powered Compression
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly identifies this risk: 'technological advances and accelerated adoption of renewable sources of energy could reduce demand for natural gas in our markets' and 'increased focus of our customers on reducing emissions from, or the use of, combustion engines in compression could increase demand for electric compressors or require us to make modifications to our existing natural gas-powered units'. This is a medium- to long-term risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning was found in the 10-K text. The company references technology investments and digital transformation, including enhancements to remote monitoring capabilities, but without explicit reference to AI.
